summary: Deterministic stt-window-v1 window planner in new @kms/speech package. Pure function: splits a monotonic [0, durationMs) timeline into 300s windows with 2s overlap between consecutive full windows; gaps become backfill_required ranges and are never spanned by a window. Stable SHA-256 plan hash over canonical (sorted-key) JSON. Capture-chunk independent: validates gaps against strict GapEntrySchema, drops reason before hashing, never reads chunkId/chunkIndex.
additionalTests: zero-width gap ignored (startMs === endMs produces no backfill range; plan equals no-gap reference)
negative startMs rejected by GapEntrySchema (input contract enforced)
contained second gap merged into first (reason-independent merge)
adjacent (touching) gaps merged into one continuous range
same-startMs gaps merged deterministically (tiebreak by endMs)
gap straddling the end after a full window: overlapMs=0 (next segment is a backfill range, not an overlapping window)

captureChunkIndependence.claim: planner operates exclusively on durationMs + monotonic GapEntry ranges; never reads chunkId/chunkIndex
mechanisms: Input gaps validated through GapEntrySchema.parse() (.strict()) — unknown fields such as chunkIndex are rejected (monotonic_only test asserts this)
normalizeGaps drops the reason field before planning and before hashing — only {startMs, endMs} ranges influence the plan and the hash
planHash = sha256(canonicalJSON({version, durationMs, gap-ranges, windows, backfillRanges})) — no identity/chunk fields in the hash input
Algorithm advances purely on the monotonic timeline cursor t; never references chunk boundaries

hashDeterminism.algorithm: SHA-256 over canonicalStringify({version, durationMs, gaps, windows, backfillRanges})
hashDeterminism.canonicalJsonRules: recursive alphabetical key sort at every object depth; arrays preserve order; primitives via String() / JSON.stringify(); whitespace-free; functions/symbols/undefined map to null
hashDeterminism.exportedForRecompute: canonicalStringify is exported so P14 reconciliation can recompute a plan hash independently and verify TranscriptRunPart lineage

overlapSemantics.rule: overlapMs = OVERLAP_MS (2000) iff (endMs - startMs === WINDOW_MS) AND (endMs < durationMs) AND (endMs does not fall inside/at-start of a gap); otherwise 0
overlapSemantics.metadataOnly: overlap does not extend coverage — two_hour test asserts sum of unique window coverage === durationMs
overlapSemantics.lastWindow: never has overlap (verified by overlap_only_between_full_windows test)
overlapSemantics.gapFollowed: when a gap begins at a full window's end, overlap is 0 because the next segment is a backfill range, not an overlapping window (verified by gap-straddling-end test)

algorithmNotes: Three-case loop: (1) t inside a gap -> backfill range, advance past gap; (2) gap starts within prospective window -> shrink window to gap start, emit backfill; (3) no gap -> full/clipped window with optional overlap.

Dead-code guards removed: gapEnd > t and gapEnd > end are provably always true given the find() predicates and normalizeGaps zero-width filtering, so the conditionals were removed for branch-coverage honesty.
Final WindowPlanSchema.parse(plan) is defense-in-depth — the plan is constructed to satisfy the schema by construction.

consumedInterfaces.domain: @kms/domain (workspace:*) — GapEntrySchema + GapEntry from packages/domain/src/transcript/schemas.ts (pre-existing P02 contract, unchanged by T01/T02)

noProviderSdkImports: grep over packages/speech/src confirms only node:crypto, zod, @kms/domain imports — no Deepgram/whisper/SDK types in the planner

modified: pnpm-lock.yaml (additive packages/speech section + @types/node hoist; remainder of diff is pre-existing baseline churn outside T02 ownership)
